title: The Time of Positive Conversion of Interferon-γ Releasing Assay After Tuberculosis Exposure
brief_summary: The aim is to evaluate the time of positive conversion after exposure to smear positive pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) in a platoon of Korean military, a closed communal setting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All soldiers who assigned to the military platoon where a tuberculosis outbreak occurred

Exclusion Criteria:

* Soldiers who could not complete study or refused the study protocol
study_population: A military unit in South Korean Army
